_comment: Single source of truth for the site's Content Security Policy.
Wix sends no security headers and offers no way to add them: there is no
_headers file, no header configuration in the dashboard, nothing. So the
<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"> tag in each page is the only
CSP production actually enforces, and these strings are what those tags
must contain. tools/check-pages.mjs asserts it page by page; server.py
reads the same file so local development matches.
What meta cannot do: frame-ancestors is ignored in a meta tag, and there is
no X-Frame-Options either. The site is therefore framable in production and
clickjacking is not mitigated. headerOnly below is sent by server.py so the
local server is honest about the difference, and README.md records the gap.
'unsafe-eval' and inline styles are required by the DC runtime, not chosen:
support.js compiles component code with new Function, and the pages carry
inline style attributes throughout. Inline <script> blocks are NOT allowed.

policies.base: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
policies.locator: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval' https://esm.sh; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://tile.openstreetmap.org; connect-src 'self' https://photon.komoot.io https://www.wixapis.com https://edge.wixapis.com; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

_locatorNote: Only findBrisaBay.html gets the wider policy, and every origin in it is
there for a reason the page can point at:
photon.komoot.io        geocoding for the search box
edge.wixapis.com        where the Stockists collection query actually goes
esm.sh                  where @wix/sdk and @wix/data are imported from
That last one is the weak link and should not stay: esm.sh is a third-party
CDN serving executable code, the specifier is an unpinned major range, and
allowing it in script-src reopens exactly what locator-config.js vendored
Leaflet locally to avoid. Vendoring the two Wix modules into assets/vendor/
would return this policy to script-src 'self'. See README.md.
